outcome: Land HMS Ambush research mission: empirically test whether Method 3 (1D heat-equation inverse problem) can extrapolate x_core past the probe tip on the existing real CSVs, characterise its parameter confidence (Hessian + bootstrap), and quantify robustness under sigma=0.5/1.0/2.0 deg C noise. Output is a research report with a clear go/no-go recommendation; no production wiring.
success_metric: Synthetic ground-truth recovery: known x_core_true=-0.15 recovered within 95 percent Hessian CI in at least 90 of 100 seeds. On real CSVs: report median x_core, 95 percent CI, alpha-x_core correlation, residual SSE. Robustness: x_core spread under sigma=1.0 noise, compared against parabolic-extrapolation spread on the same fixtures. Report committed at tests/baselines/heat_equation_extrapolation_research.md.
